WorkTwill 是本地个人工作台，通过引用把文件与网页按工作事项组织起来，不: WorkTwill is a local workspace that organizes files and saved links by reference without moving originals. Explore features, use cases, offline use, and current support limits.
WorkTwill 是本地个人工作台：搜索已授权的文件与已保存的网页链接，围绕一: WorkTwill is a local personal workspace. Search authorized files and saved links, create a workspace around a piece of work, and organize resources by reference while keeping originals in place. File search and organization work offline, with no account or AI setup.
明确授权的本地文件，以及手动保存的网址；不会自动扫描全盘。: Local files you explicitly authorize and URLs you save manually. No automatic whole-drive scan.
工作区保存引用。同一份文件可以关联多个工作区，不复制磁盘原件。: Workspaces store references. One file can belong to multiple workspaces without copying the original on disk.
已索引的名称、路径、已保存网址及工作区；当前不搜索文件正文。: Indexed names, paths, saved URLs, and workspaces. Document contents are not currently searched.
用系统默认软件打开文件，用默认浏览器打开网页。: Files open in the system's default app; links open in the default browser.
索引、关联和收藏保存在电脑的应用数据区，不自动上传官网。: Indexes, relationships, and favorites stay in the app data directory on your computer. They are not automatically uploaded to this website.
macOS Apple 芯片的早期候选包；Windows 与 Intel Mac: An early macOS Apple Silicon candidate. No Windows or Intel Mac build is available yet.
适合什么工作？: What kind of work is it for?
适合需要反复取回多份文档、表格、PDF 和参考网页的个人办公场景，例如客户合同、: It is intended for individual office work that repeatedly brings you back to documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, and reference links, such as client contracts, onboarding, or event planning. Keep your existing folders and create a workspace as an entry point for each project.
例如，合同原件在文档目录，预算表在另一个项目文件夹，客户网站在浏览器收藏中。把它: For example, a contract lives in Documents, a budget in another project folder, and a client website in your bookmarks. Link them to one workspace to continue from a single entry point. The same budget can also belong to another workspace.
当前能做什么，不能承诺什么？: What is available, and what is not promised?
支持文件与网页引用、全局搜索、工作区、收藏和有来源标注的动态。网页保存的是链接，: File and web references, global search, workspaces, favorites, and activity with source labels are implemented. Saved web resources are links, not offline page copies.
没有文件正文全文检索、OCR、云同步、团队协作或内置 AI Agent；这些不属: Document full-text search, OCR, cloud sync, team collaboration, and a built-in AI agent are not currently available.
部分同物理对象改名与同卷移动已有定位实现。跨卷、替换保存和完整原生取回仍有验证边: Some relocation after a rename or move of the same physical file within a volume is implemented. Cross-volume moves, replacement saves, and complete native retrieval still have verification gaps. Automatic recovery after every move or rename is not promised.
当前包未完成 Apple 签名、公证和全部正式发行验收。先使用资料副本体验，并保: The current build has not completed Apple signing, notarization, or all release acceptance checks. Try copies of your resources first and keep your own original-file backups.
文件检索、工作区关联和本地浏览不需要联网。添加网址时，可选的自动标题功能会访问目: File search, workspace links, and local browsing do not need a network connection. Optional title fetching contacts the destination website and uses Cloudflare DNS. You can disable it and enter titles manually. Opening a link uses your default browser to visit an external website.

在个人工作台点击「添加管理位置」，选择已有文件夹；也可以通过「选择本地文件」只授: In My workspace, choose Add managed location and select an existing folder, or use Choose local files to authorize only what you need. You do not have to allow the whole Documents folder. Unconfirmed locations are not scanned automatically.
第二步：搜索并建立工作区: Step 2: search and create a workspace
在顶部搜索框输入文件名的一部分，例如「合作协议」。新建「客户 A 合同」工作区，: Type part of a filename, such as agreement, into the top search field. Create a Client A contract workspace and add the contract and budget from results. You can also select several resources first and choose Create workspace and add.
扫描仍在进行时只能找到已索引的资料。没有结果时，先检查授权范围和扫描状态；当前不: While scanning is in progress, only indexed resources can be found. If there are no results, check permissions and scan status. Search does not currently look inside document contents.
在工作区选择「添加网页」，粘贴客户网页地址。标题自动填写后可以修改；不希望联网取: Choose Add web link in the workspace and paste the client's URL. You can edit the fetched title, or turn fetching off and type it yourself. WorkTwill saves a URL reference, not an offline page or a browser login session.
第四步：用熟悉的软件继续: Step 4: continue in your usual apps
双击合同，用系统默认办公软件打开原件；打开网页时使用默认浏览器。WorkTwil: Double-click the contract to open the original in the system's default office app. Links use the default browser. WorkTwill itself does not rewrite originals. Some editor saves and file-identity scenarios are still unverified, so try copies first.
预算表也与另一件工作相关时，可以再关联到另一个工作区。两个工作区引用同一份文件，: If the budget is also relevant to another project, link it to another workspace. Both point to the same file without creating a second disk copy. Removing it from one workspace leaves the other relationship intact.

文件改名、跨卷移动、替换保存或权限变化后，可能需要重新授权或明确「重新指向」。无: Renames, cross-volume moves, replacement saves, or changed permissions may require renewed access or explicit relinking. An uncertain identity is never accepted merely because names match.
